references.text: The verses form coherent parts of the same story: cause (deceit and dishonor) and consequence (revenge and murder).
Narrative connection where trust in the lie (v.18) leads directly to destruction (v.26).
Narrative connection: their persuasion (v.20) creates the situation that enables the revenge attack (v.26).
Causal connection: the offense (v.2) is the direct cause of the execution of revenge (v.26).
Narrative contrast: negotiations for peace and marriage (v.8) end in violent destruction (v.26).
